definitions: To present as worthy of notice, recommendation, or praise.
To entrust for safekeeping or to commit to the care of.
To recommend as worthy of confidence or regard.
examples: The judge will commend the officer for bravery.
I commend this book to all students of history.
He commended his soul to God.
We commend her for her dedication.
pastTenses: commended (past simple), commended (present perfect), commended (past perfect)
